The test image displays a leaf that is entirely brown, desiccated, and curled, indicating complete tissue death. This widespread necrosis is characteristic of Die_Back disease. I examined a reference image for Die_Back (`CyberVisionAg/Prepared_Dataset/Mango_Leaf/Die_Back/merged/Mango_Leaf_14.jpg`), which showed an identical pattern of a dried, shriveled, and dead leaf. The other classes are visually inconsistent; Anthracnose would show distinct lesions, Powdery Mildew would have a white powdery coating, and Sooty Mould would appear as a black layer, none of which are present. The strong resemblance to the Die_Back reference confirms the diagnosis.
